description: Make one of the owner's agents: it gets its own wallet on Robinhood Chain, owned by the owner's AINDEX sign-in, and trades on Lighter and Robinhood Chain as its strategy says. Before calling, show the person the plan (plan_agent) and confirm the name and the strategy. It trades on its own and reports after each trade. It thinks with this app (thinks_with "your_ai", the default: no model cost, its checks run here with schedule_checks) unless the person asks for a model AINDEX runs on credits ("aindex"; about_agents lists them and their prices). Answers with the wallet address to fund and what to do next. Needs this chat connected (connect_account) with Run my agents.

asks_first.description: Leave out: agents trade on their own and report after each trade. true is an older mode, kept only for the person who asks for it by name.

every_minutes.description: How often it checks, in minutes. Leave out for the usual schedule.

follow.description: Make a copy instead: the id of a public agent to copy, or any Hyperliquid account's address (0x...) to copy that trader. The copy mirrors its trades with its own money, needs no AI and pays no credits; AI can be added later on the website.

model.description: With thinks_with aindex: the model id, as about_agents lists it (e.g. ~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest).

strategy.description: What it should do, in the owner's words: markets, sizes, risk, when to act. Not needed with follow.

thinks_with.description: your_ai (default): this app thinks for it. aindex: only if the person asks for a model AINDEX runs, paid from credits. code: no AI at all; the person's own code or this app drives it with call_agent_tools, and its strategy runs every minute.

name: create_agent
title: Make a new agent with its own wallet
